correctness.rationale: Correctness PASSES on the narrow lemmas. Lemma 1 (deg N = c1(Y).C - 2 from 0->T_C->T_Y|_C->N->0, deg T_P1=2) is standard adjunction and correctly gives c1.C=0 and Sigma.C=0 for N=O(-1)+O(-1) when [Sigma]=c1(Y). Lemma 2 (each transverse holomorphic meeting contributes local index +1, further holomorphic intersections nonnegative, so two transverse points give Sigma.C>=2) is standard positivity of complex intersections; transversality implies C not contained in Sigma so sum of multiplicities equals homological pairing. Contradiction 0>=2 refutes C+ in any smooth block with Sigma in |-K|, independent of blow-up centres, matching r, or C- analysis. No computation beyond integers, no experimental evidence misrepresented as proof, and scope limitation (does not rule out other associatives) is honestly stated. The gap is not correctness but that A is shown undefined rather than obstructed as a defined class, which is a value/admission issue.

originality.rationale: Originality FAILS. The three normalized search forms (literal rigid S1xS2 Bera gluing impossibility; equivalent (-1,-1)/O(-1)^2 adjunction c1.C=0 versus positivity formulations; dominance query for stronger TCS associative theorems, broader threefold curve theory, censuses and databases) were submitted in one scope_literature_search call covering SerpBase, OpenAlex, Crossref and OpenAIRE with fused results. Nearest priors found were Bera IMRN rnag070 / arXiv:2209.00156 transverse gluing theorem, Bera thesis, Corti-Haskins-Nordstrom-Pacini semi-Fano TCS theory, and standard (-1,-1)-curve literature. No prior states the named-pair headline verbatim, but verbatim novelty is insufficient: the headline is mechanically implied by textbook adjunction deg N=c1.C-2 plus positivity, i.e. a corollary/repackaging of a known stronger general fact. Synonymous notation, dual/encoding variants, and broader-class coverage all collapse to the same c1.C=0 versus >=2 contradiction. See decisive_checks for adversarial checklist.

value.rationale: Value FAILS with explicit ADMISSION_DEFECT. The TARGET permitted a complete negative answer via volume-bound, intersection-number or deformation-index obstruction for a well-defined glued class A, but the result shows the posited C+ is contradictory on its face by elementary adjunction (-2+2=0!=2) in any smooth anticanonical block, so the glued class A never forms and the compound existence claim is vacuous. Per STANDARD and TARGET policy, a negative resolution that is only a type/normalization error, vacuity, cheap small-instance mismatch, direct lookup, or arbitrary parameter fact fails value even if literally false, and Admission was required to rule out exactly such cheap defects before research. This is a textbook exercise mechanically implied by standard results, not a new theorem, boundary, census, benchmark, or motivated exact invariant of a natural object that a future researcher would need to retrieve; certification/replayability does not create value. No bounded topic-preserving addition can supply a substantive result without changing the problem, so not repairable. ADMISSION_DEFECT: admitted target hypothesis violated c1.C=0 versus >=2 on its face.

checked_sources: Bera, Associative Submanifolds in Twisted Connected Sum G2-Manifolds, IMRN rnag070 (2026) / arXiv:2209.00156: proves ACyl associative gluing under transverse intersection hypothesis, rephrased for holomorphic curves and special Lagrangians into algebraic-geometric and topological conditions, yielding rigid associatives of types S^3, RP^3, RP^3#RP^3 — the stated Bera route whose C+ input is shown impossible here.

Bera thesis, Associative submanifolds of G2-manifolds (HU Berlin, 2023): Lagrangian-intersection formulation of the same transverse gluing theorem (Theorem 3.2), confirming the general method and that the draft targets its hypothesis rather than its conclusion.

Corti-Haskins-Nordstrom-Pacini, G2-manifolds and associative submanifolds via semi-Fano 3-folds, Duke Math. J. (2015) / arXiv:1207.4470: semi-Fano ACyl Calabi-Yau building blocks Y\Sigma with Sigma in |-K_Y|, K3 matching problem, and rigid associatives — establishes the anticanonical TCS setting [Sigma]=c1(Y) used in Lemma 1.

Standard threefold adjunction and positivity theory (textbook algebraic/complex geometry): from 0->T_P1->T_Y|_C->N->0, deg N = c1(Y).C - 2, so O(-1)+O(-1) forces c1.C=0 and Sigma.C=0; transverse holomorphic divisor-curve meetings contribute +1 each with nonnegative further multiplicities — jointly implies no (-1,-1) P1 meets anticanonical divisor twice.

Cotterill and general (-1,-1)-curve literature on Fano/Calabi-Yau threefolds (e.g., O(-1)^2 rigidity, finiteness on quintic): confirms (-1,-1) means rigid with degree -2 and c1.C=0, hence disjoint from anticanonical class — the synonymous-notation prior that mechanically implies the headline.

broader_coverage.evidence: Adjunction exact sequence 0->T_P1->T_Y|_C->N->0 giving deg N = c1(Y).C - 2 holds for every smooth rational curve in every smooth complex threefold, far broader than the stated blow-up of P^3 in a line plus an elliptic curve; Bera gluing theorem and CHNP TCS theory cover general semi-Fano blocks and general ACyl associatives, not the named pair.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The submitted claim (no (-1,-1) curve meeting anticanonical K3 twice in the named block) is a strict special case of the general fact that any (-1,-1) P1 in any smooth threefold satisfies Sigma.C = 0 for any anticanonical Sigma. The broader theorem substantively implies the headline, so originality fails as special-case corollary.
broader_coverage.search: searched for stronger theorems, broader object classes, larger parameter ranges, exhaustive censuses or classifications that could subsume the named Y+/Y- pair: general smooth threefold rational-curve adjunction, semi-Fano building-block curve theory, TCS associative existence and obstruction theorems

claim_vs_prior_implication.evidence: Prior adjunction gives Sigma.C = 0 for N = O(-1)+O(-1); prior positivity gives Sigma.C >= 2 for two transverse holomorphic meetings plus nonnegative further multiplicities. Conjunction yields 0 >= 2 contradiction, which is exactly the DRAFT proof; Bera hypotheses additionally require algebraic-geometric transversality that the draft shows can never be met for this (-1,-1) data.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Title or embedding similarity was not used; literal hypothesis-conclusion comparison shows prior results jointly entail the headline without additional ideas. The finding is therefore only a recomputation, certificate, corollary, or repackaging of a known stronger elementary fact, so originality FAILS even though no prior source states the named-pair headline verbatim.
claim_vs_prior_implication.search: compared headline claim literally against prior theorem hypotheses and conclusions: adjunction degree plus positivity of complex intersections versus claimed impossibility of C-plus and undefined glued class A and no rigid S1xS2 by stated route

equivalent_formulations.evidence: Fused literature search returned Bera transverse-gluing theorem (IMRN rnag070 / arXiv:2209.00156) with algebraic-geometric transverse conditions, Corti-Haskins-Nordstrom-Pacini semi-Fano TCS construction, and standard (-1,-1)-curve literature (e.g., Cotterill on O(-1)^2 curves); standard adjunction deg N = c1(Y).C - 2 appears in all threefold curve treatments and equates (-1,-1) with c1.C = 0.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Under synonymous notation the headline is exactly c1(Y).C = 0 versus Sigma.C >= 2. The (-1,-1) hypothesis is by definition rigidity with degree -2, so the equivalent first-Chern formulation is covered by the textbook adjunction identity; no distinct notation, dual, complement, incidence-graph, or matrix encoding escapes that identity, so equivalence does not create novelty.

exact_database_or_table.evidence: No database lists a (-1,-1) rational curve meeting an anticanonical K3 divisor twice, because adjunction forbids it; fused results contain no table entry for the exact named Y-plus/Y-minus gluing pair with such C-plus, and CHNP/Bera tables concern existing rigid associatives of types S^3, RP^3, not the impossible S1xS2 data.
exact_database_or_table.reasoning: Absence from a table does not establish priority here: the absence is the vacuous consequence of the general adjunction prohibition, not a new exhaustive census or classification. The exact-parameter search therefore does not rescue originality; the claim is a forbidden entry implied by theory, not a newly recorded datum.
